what_this_is: Filter columns the server declares for a screen, from GET /data/WM/rpux/filter/columns/{filterType}. Discovered on the Check In screen. filterType codes were harvested from traffic this project had already captured, so this covers the screens seen so far and not necessarily every screen in the product.
not_the_same_as: index/filterable-columns.json, which records what this deployment actually honoured when a filter was fired at it. This file is a declaration; that file is a measurement. Where they disagree, believe the measurement about this instance and this file about intent.
